about: Host Checks (Host Diagnostics): read-only checks of the things on a host that most often explain a failed snapshot or backup. Each group is one check box. Events are counted, never judged beyond their own meaning; the newest event's own text is shown, as an event id alone does not name the cause. Drivers are listed as found, not as expected. Registry values are read as numbers; an absent value is reported as the Windows default.
